name: vibesdk-user-api-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda handler for user stats (worker/api/routes/statsRoutes.ts) and custom model-provider listing (worker/api/routes/modelProviderRoutes.ts), wired to vibesdk-db-analytics, vibesdk-db-model-config, and vibesdk-auth-orchestration (token validation only). Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../user-api-lambda.zip handler.js
